title: Power Bound in Terms of the Binary Logarithm
statement: For all natural numbers $k,n$, one has $n^k+1\le (2^{k^2}+2)n^{\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor}$, where the exponent is the integer part of the base-two logarithm (with $\lfloor\log_2 0\rfloor=0$).
